description: The tef release organises six field experiments for crop-growth modelling under nitrogen supply and water stress. It contains one irrigation experiment, one cultivar trial and four fertiliser experiments. Five experiments took place in Ethiopia; the cultivar trial took place in the United States. Harvard Dataverse’s public dataset API confirmed the named version 1.0 resource and CC0 1.0. DataCite lists a 7Z archive and no price. A food-supply or irrigation modeller could use the treatment observations to calibrate tef growth simulations and water or nitrogen response. These are six selected experiments, not a national production survey, and the countries do not share identical treatment designs. The public abstract does not state all experiment dates or field-variable completeness. No archive was downloaded or parsed. This resource is related to the wheat, potato and cotton calibration releases in this review as another crop benchmark, but it has its own DOI and crop. The full duplicate scan found no catalogue identity match.
name: Experimental field data for modeling the growth response of tef to nitrogen fertilizer and water stress
